subject: Follow-up: CloudHub connector sync — missed session and rebook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Velez <elena@cloudhub.io>, Mark Ritter <mark.ritter@cloudhub.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:05:00Z
Subject: CloudHub connector demo — confirm timing for today

Hi Elena / Mark —

Quick note to confirm our demo for today at 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (30 minutes). Camila from our integrations team and Sergio from partner ops will join to walk through the connector setup and timeline.

Agenda (short):
- 5m intros
- 15m live demo of connector (auth, initial sync)
- 5m rollout plan and next steps
- 5m Q&A

If anything changed on your end, let me know — otherwise we’ll meet on the same Zoom link in the calendar invite. Attaching an updated agenda. (attached: connector-demo-agenda.pdf)

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Velez <elena@cloudhub.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T17:15:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudHub connector demo — follow up — missed call

Hi Elena —

We waited on the call for ~15 minutes but didn’t see anyone join and the calendar shows no cancellation. I wanted to check in — are you still interested in the connector walkthrough this week?

If the timing didn’t work, no problem — can you propose 2x 30-minute windows that suit your team, or feel free to grab a slot on my calendar here: https://calendar.redwood.com/jordan/15min?slot=2026-06-21T14:00Z

Camila and Sergio are available for short notice rebooks tomorrow and Monday; we want to make sure we answer any integration questions and surface any prerequisites ahead of a pilot.

Thanks,
Jordan

Date: 2026-06-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudHub connector demo — follow up — missed call

Jordan —

So, so sorry about the no-show. We had an urgent outage in our QA environment that pulled Mark and myself into a firefight at the same time as the meeting — we should have sent a heads-up. My apologies for the inconvenience.

We are absolutely still interested. Proposed windows (PT):
- Mon 6/21 10:30–11:00 PT
- Mon 6/21 15:00–15:30 PT
- Tue 6/22 09:00–09:30 PT

Can you confirm which works for your team? Also, if it helps for a shorter run-through that focuses only on auth and initial sync we can compress to 20 minutes.

Thanks for being flexible — Elena
Elena Velez
Partner Programs | CloudHub
elena@cloudhub.io
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Velez <elena@cloudhub.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Mark Ritter <mark.ritter@cloudhub.io>
Date: 2026-06-19T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudHub connector demo — follow up — missed call

Thanks Elena — no worries, glad you’re ok and appreciate the note.

Camila and Sergio are good for the first two windows on Monday. We can do the abbreviated 20-minute auth + sync run-through if you prefer to get unblockers out of the way quickly. I’ve proposed the 10:30 PT slot in your calendar and left the invite open for you to accept.

Quick logistics:
- Zoom link: same as invite (I’ll paste in the calendar once you accept)
- Please share the client ID/redirect details or pre-prod tenant URL if you want us to demo against a staging environment
- Attached is a one-page checklist (connector-demo-agenda.pdf) — Camila will lead the auth steps.

If anything changes, ping me directly +1 (415) 555-0182.

Jordan

Elena and I will bring access to a staging tenant; I’ll drop the staging URL and temporary creds in the calendar notes an hour before the call.

See you Monday — looking forward to it.
